messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content: The viscous friction force depends on the velocity and the damping coefficient of the system. System parameters such as the angular velocity and the proportionality constant determine the magnitude of this force. Force is typically modeled as being proportional to the velocity of the oscillating body. Body motion in a physical pendulum should account for this effect when the pendulum swings through a viscous medium. Medium resistance becomes significant when damping cannot be neglected in the model. Model accuracy improves when viscous friction is included for pendulums operating in fluids or resistive environments.
